name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my kitchen expansion?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for my kitchen expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a general contractor for your kitchen expansion, prioritize experience with similar projects and a strong portfolio. Verify their licensing, insurance, and bond. Check references from past clients and read online reviews. Evaluate their communication style, as clear and consistent communication is crucial during a large-scale project. Obtain detailed, written estimates and a clear contract outlining the scope, timeline, and payment schedule. Look for a contractor familiar with local Bay Area permitting processes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, strong references, clear communication, detailed estimates, and familiarity with local permits.
